title: Fate/stay night: Unlimited Blade Works
synopsis:
Fuyuki City - a city surrounded by the sea and mountains becomes the setting for an ancient ritual. Seven masters are given control of heroic spirits in order to realize the mythical Holy Grail, which is said to grant its owner any wish. These heroic spirits or servants represent legendary heroes of various classes: "Saber," "Lancer," "Archer," "Rider," "Caster," "Assassin," and "Berserker." Each master will enter into a contract with their chosen servant and battle the others to the death until only one pair remains... This is the "Holy Grail War."

The young and capable mage, Rin Tohsaka, prepares for her long-awaited Fifth Holy Grail War to begin... With her servant Archer, Rin enters the Holy Grail War as the sole heir to the prestigious Tohsaka family after her father's death. But when Shirou Emiya, a boy from Rin's school, unwittingly becomes a Master and is fatally wounded in battle, she has no choice but to save him. With Shirou and his servant Saber, Rin sets out to strike down the conspiracies surrounding the Holy Grail War. Will the Holy Grail bless Rin and Shirou's path toward victory or will they be cursed with defeat?

(Source: Aniplex of America)

Notes:

- Includes Prologue.

- The first, second and last episodes aired with a runtime of ~48 minutes as opposed to the standard 24 minute long episode.

- Based on the second route from TYPE-MOON's visual novel, Fate/stay night.

episodes.title: Winter Day, Fateful Night
episodes.synopsis: Shirou Emiya's life was saved by Kiritsugu Emiya during the great Fuyuki City fire ten years ago. After school one day, he witnesses a battle between two Servants. Lancer, who realized that someone has been watching this battle that should not be seen, tries to kill Shirou on his Master's orders. Shirou was resuscitated by Rin, but he is attacked by Lancer again that night. While Shirou bears the brunt of Lancer's attacks, a Servant is summoned in front of his eyes. (Source: Official Site)

episodes.title: When the Curtain Goes Up
episodes.synopsis: Shirou goes to the Fuyuki Church with Rin, who had rushed to the Emiya estate after Lancer's attack. Shirou is told about the Holy Grail Wars by Kotomine Kirei, its overseer, and is shocked by what he hears; however, when he learns that the great fire 10 years ago, which he himself was injured in, was caused by the Holy Grail War, he decides to fight in it as a Master. (Source: Official Site)

episodes.title: The First Battle
episodes.synopsis: After Shirou and the others leave the church, their way is blocked by a Servant and a little girl who introduces herself as Illyasviel. Rin and the others find themselves hard pressed by Berserker's overwhelming might. In his very first battle, Shirou learns just how powerless he truly is. (Source: Official Site)

episodes.title: Finding the Will to Fight
episodes.synopsis: Summoned by Fujimura, Shirou and Saber set out to his school. Shirou tries to explain away Saber, who is unable to dematerialize, but Fujimura and Sakura both end up staying at Shirou's house somehow... Elsewhere, Rin had gone to visit the site of the gas leak and, based on faint traces of mana there, determines that Caster was behind it. (Source: Official Site)

episodes.title: Dancing After School
episodes.synopsis: Shirou goes to school without Saber. Rin, annoyed at Shirou for acting alone, waits until no one is around and attacks him. Rin corners him, but then they hear a female student scream. When they call a truce and go to where the scream came from, they find... (Source: Official Site)

episodes.title: Mirage
episodes.synopsis: Rin and Shirou have formed a truce to deal with the other Master that is hiding in the school. But no sooner have they done so when Shinji tells Shirou that he is Rider’s Master and asks him to work together. That night, Shirou had been practicing magic in the storehouse, but the next thing he knows, he finds himself at Ryudou Temple, which Caster has made into her lair. (Source: Official Site)

episodes.title: Reward for the Desperate Struggle
episodes.synopsis: When Saber arrives at Ryudou Temple to rescue Shirou, she finds her way blocked by Assassin. Saber is unable to break through his skill with the sword, which is far beyond what one would expect from the Assassin class. Elsewhere, Archer and Caster face off in the courtyard of Ryudou Temple, where Shirou is being held. As they talk, Shirou is disgusted by Archer’s way of thinking. (Source: Official Site)

episodes.title: Winter Days, Whereabouts of Mind
episodes.synopsis: After training with Saber, Shirou goes to school. During lunch recess, Shirou gets fresh confirmation of his united front with Rin, but at that moment, the magic circle that had been laid out at the school is activated. Shirou uses a Command Seal and summons Saber, and he and Rin set out to reach Shinji to put an end to the circle. (Source: Official Site)

episodes.title: The Distance Between Them
episodes.synopsis: Rider, who protected Shinji from Caster, is eliminated. Rin had concluded that Caster’s Master is someone at school, but she focuses instead on formulating a strategy to smooth over Archer and Shirou’s relationship. Elsewhere, Shinji, who has lost his Servant, goes to Kirei to seek refuge at the church. When Shinji expresses his dissatisfaction with Rider, Kirei informs him that a new Servant is available. (Source: Official Site)

episodes.title: The Fifth Contractor
episodes.synopsis: Rin, having concluded from Issei’s testimony that Kuzuki is Caster’s Master, puts together a plan to attack him with Shirou that same day. Seeing Kuzuki offer no resistance when struck by Rin’s sneak attack, Shirou runs out to him, but then Caster appears. When Shirou lays out Caster’s atrocities and tries to win Kuzuki over, Kuzuki reveals his true nature. (Source: Official Site)

episodes.title: A Visitor Approaches Lightly
episodes.synopsis: Shirou and the others fight off Kuzuki and Caster. However, Shirou loses all feeling in the left half of his body as a result of forcibly using too much mana. Rin visits him at home the following day under the pretext that he missed their regular check-in, but she then stays the night for some reason. And then, when Archer sees Shirou’s condition, he says that he has seen such symptoms before. (Source: Official Site)

episodes.title: The Final Choice
episodes.synopsis: The morning after Rin spends the night, Shirou and Saber go out on a date with Rin at her suggestion. Forgetting about the fighting, the three of them unwind, but they come under attack from Caster once again. Caster presses Shirou, who can’t fight back because she’s taken Fujimura hostage, to join her. Shirou flatly rejects her, but Shirou has both his Command Seals and Saber stolen from him by Caster, who becomes enraged at his response. (Source: Official Site)
